📖 How to use

      
  1. Enter the sample mean, standard deviation and size.
  2. Pick the confidence level.
  3. Press Calculate to see the interval and margin of error.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
z or t — which is used?
z for n ≥ 30 (central limit theorem); the t-distribution with df = n−1 for smaller samples, via a built-in t-table.
What does 95% confident mean?
If you repeated the sampling, about 95% of such intervals would capture the true population mean.
How do I shrink the interval?
Increase n (margin falls as 1/√n) or accept a lower confidence level.
